description: This file defines a middleware class for handling exceptions in an ASP.NET Core application. It intercepts exceptions thrown during HTTP request processing and returns appropriate JSON error responses, differentiating between duplicate exceptions and generic exceptions.

classes.name: ExceptionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware for handling exceptions during HTTP request processing, converting exceptions into JSON responses.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Main middleware execution method that invokes the next delegate and handles exceptions.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions by setting the appropriate status code and response content based on exception type.
